purpose: Reference examples of agency, conflict, subjective goals and voluntary initiative during Class Poll.
truth_vs_belief_gate: Public statements, private monologues, and narrator inference have separate epistemic authority.
future_divergence_gate: No transition from later school volumes becomes actor memory or a deterministic future action in a fork.
stability_gate: No stable numeric weights, guaranteed cooperation, coerced romance, or irreversible personality conversion.
